description: A Rural Capacity Map is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Headwaters Economics. This map can help identify communities where investments in staffing and expertise are needed to support infrastructure and climate resilience projects. The Rural Capacity Index can be used by communities to advocate for resources. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Changing Seasons, Drought, Flooding – General, High Winds, Severe Winter Weather, Shifting Species, Habitats, and Ecosystems, Vector-Borne Disease, Wildfire. Assets: Agriculture and Food Supply, Critical Facilities, Cultural and Community Services, Economy, People. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
